claims.quote: Barlow's dwarf cichlid, Apistogramma barlowi, may be endemic to the Ampiyacu River system, an affluent of the Amazon in northeastern Peru.
Current knowledge indicates that this species may be endemic to the Ampiyacu River system, an affluent of the Amazon mainstream in northeastern Peru.
